---
title: "PPI → AKI after ICI"
subtitle: "New-user cohort, time-varying Cox model, 730-day horizon"
---

## The question

Among patients who were **not already on a proton-pump inhibitor** when they
started immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, does *starting* a PPI raise the
hazard of acute kidney injury over the following two years?

This is a sub-study of the ICI-CKD cohort. It reuses that project's baseline
covariates and rebuilds the exposure and the outcome from raw RPDR extracts,
because both were affected by bugs documented in
[the plan and bug audit](PPI_ANALYSIS_PLAN.md).

## Pipeline

| Stage | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| **Plan & bug audit** | [`PPI_ANALYSIS_PLAN.md`](PPI_ANALYSIS_PLAN.md) | Every confirmed defect with file:line references, and the analysis plan that follows from it |
| **Shared helpers** | [`R/ppi_functions.R`](R/ppi_functions.R) | Single definition of every function — privacy guards, rolling lookbacks, the fixed `create_aki()`, counting-process construction |
| **Data management** | [`data_management.qmd`](data_management.qmd) | Cohort ledger, exposure derivation, repaired AKI outcome, time-varying covariates, counting-process frames |
| **Analysis** | [`analysis.qmd`](analysis.qmd) | Time-varying Cox models M0-M12, induction ladder, mirror window, death negative control, active comparator, competing risk |

No function is defined twice anywhere in this project. Two divergent copies of
`create_aki()` — one in `Final cohort/aki.Rmd`, one in the ICI-CKD
`data_management.qmd` — silently disagreed at the KDIGO boundary, and that is
the defect the single-source-of-truth layout exists to prevent.

## Cohort

| Step | N |
|---|---|
| ICI-CKD analytic master, as saved | 17,721 |
| − RPDR death date before ICI start | 17,718 |
| − PPI on or before ICI start (not new-user eligible) | −8,637 |
| = new-user eligible | 9,081 |
| − no post-ICI creatinine (AKI unascertainable) | −170 |
| **= analytic cohort** | **8,911** |

Every step is executed and asserted in code. The parent cohort's published
ledger documented seven steps but implemented five, and the saved file carries
17,721 rows against a published 17,718 — the two missing steps are re-applied
here.

## Design

**Time zero** is the first ICI dose. **Follow-up** ends at the earliest of AKI,
last creatinine, death, or 730 days. **Exposure** is time-varying: a patient who
starts a PPI on day 120 and has an AKI on day 200 contributes 120 *unexposed*
days and 80 *exposed* days, not 200 exposed days. Treating that patient as
exposed from day 0 is immortal time bias, and it is measured explicitly in the
analysis rather than assumed away.

The **death negative-control outcome** runs on its own clock. Death is
ascertained from the RPDR demographics file and does not require a lab draw, so
it is censored administratively at the pull date rather than at the last
creatinine.

## Two clocks

The analysis is reported on both. On the **ICI clock** the exposed AKI rate
exceeds the unexposed rate substantially. On the **PPI clock** — re-zeroed on
each patient's own prescription date, looking backward as well as forward — risk
in the week *before* the prescription is indistinguishable from the week after,
and peaks on the prescription day itself. A drug cannot raise risk in the week
before it is given, so that symmetry is the central object of the analysis and
appears as the mirror-window figure.

## Data privacy

`EMPI`, `MRN`, names and dates of birth are used as local join keys only and
never appear in any rendered output. `data_management.qmd` is not executed at
render time — it reads RPDR extracts that stay local. `analysis.qmd` renders
from `cache/qc.rds`, which is aggregate-only and asserted free of identifier
columns before it is written. Cells below 11 are suppressed. Free-text RPDR
fields (`Additional_Info`, `Result_Text`, `Specimen_Text`) are never read.

## Data sources (local only, not in this repo)

- `Final cohort/final_master_0114_raw.xlsx` — ICI-CKD analytic master (parent cohort)
- RPDR `_Lab.txt` (909 MB) — serial creatinine, for the outcome and draw density
- RPDR `_Med.txt` (2.3 GB) — PPI, H2RA, steroid and baseline medication exposures
- RPDR pull date 2025-09-30

`aki_0120.xlsx` is deliberately **not** used: it is the output of the AKI
lookback bug.

## Running it

```r
knitr::purl("data_management.qmd", output = "cache/data_management.R", documentation = 0)
source("cache/data_management.R")   # builds cache/, ~1 min warm / ~5 min cold
quarto::quarto_render()
```

## Dependencies

`tidyverse`, `dplyr`, `tidyr`, `purrr`, `readxl`, `writexl`, `data.table`,
`survival`, `broom`, `ggplot2`, `knitr`.
